preconditions: Owned temporary native project with two goals and a draft requirement, complete resource bindings, explicit human actor/source guards and actual writer/receipt services.
steps: Record a confirmed relation review under the real writer lock; inspect complete endpoint/context bindings, immutable revision-1 output and native receipts; replay the same request and reject changed intent, nonhuman actors, stale guards and tampered saved plans.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein `relation_review`-Artefakt MUSS die geprüfte `relation_id`, den kanonischen Relationsinhaltshash, Quell- und Ziel-ID, deren Revision und vollständigen Artefakthash, deren `relation_context_hash-v1`, Reviewer, Entscheidung, Zeitstempel und optionalen Kommentar enthalten.
oracle.scope: Native first confirmed human review: new random128 identity, exact relation/source/target IDs, revisions, full and context hashes, reviewer/time/reason/comment, recorded/approved creation through complete target checks and native journal/publication/receipt/cleanup, unchanged original files, historical request replay and immutable generic routes. The bound gates cover only the new review; general history/currentness, negative outcomes/withdrawals and CLI remain open.
